title: Vanilla Gui+
description: A low-opacity vanilla GUI that improves visibility and reduces visual clutter.
body:
# 🎨 Vanilla GUI+

## 🌊 Overview

Vanilla GUI+ refreshes Minecraft's interface with a cleaner, lower-opacity design while preserving the game's original vanilla style. Menus become less distracting, allowing more of the game world to remain visible and creating a smoother gameplay experience.

![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b4fb3a53cc698eafcc5da835868af28c73f0b36c.jpeg)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## ⚔ Features

• Lower-opacity vanilla GUI

• Cleaner inventory and menu screens

• Improved visibility behind interfaces

• Maintains the original Minecraft aesthetic

• Lightweight and easy to use

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## 🎮 Perfect For

• PvP players

• Survival gameplay

• Vanilla+ pack collections

• Players who prefer cleaner interfaces

• Everyday Minecraft use

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
